translation.name: Pab tummad karta pab Jesucristobal igal-pin mezhijad

book.name: 2 Timoteo
book.title: Pablo Ilabogus Timoteoga Karta Palmijad 2 Timoteo

content: Imi Pab-Jesucristo iti-napche kannan neg-takegal tanikil, tule-purkwismaladga tegin tule-tulabukmaladga igal-itononiko. Al an Pab-Tummad-wagin tegin an Jesucristo-wagin pega chogdo:

imi meke-ibi-tule pe-itobiel o pe-itobijulil, tenal pedin keg-chulgu Pab-Jesús-kaka-nuegangin tulemalga chunmakenab. Tenal pedin, pe pinnallégwadgin tegin pe nuekwagwadgin tulemal-oturdako melle noal pal nanemalgal, tenal Pab-Jesús-igalgin pul nuekwa nanegal, tegin pe tulemal-okannobalo Pab-Jesúsbal pul nuekwa naigugal.

Tenal ibagwengin ibe nonikodo, tulemal Pab-Jesús-igal-chunchunnadgin pal kwen turdabijul-kudamalo e-itolegedbalbi nanemalgal. Al we tulemal ichejul tule-oturdamalad-aminonimalo, e-itobi-kujiidginbi ega chunmagal.
Tegin we tulemal Pab-Jesús-kaka-chunchunnad ebemalo, tegin we tulemal pinche-chunmamaladbal naigunonimalo.

Tenal pedin, pe meke-ibimalagin nuekwa pinzheenab, pe melle tule-koelejadyob nanegal. Tenal pe wilenaidgin, pe purtigenabbal. Tenal tule-Pab-wichulmaladga pe Pab-kaka-nuegangin-chunmakedgin, pe naneenabbal, tegin pedin pel-kwapa Pab-pega-chogzhadyob pe pél arpagenabbal.
Imi antin, an iche-napi pato purkwedani. Al antin kuakwa mai, Pab-Tummadga-immal-okugnaidgin napi vino-eyonaidyob.
Tenal chulubmal nuekwa pila-imajadyob tegin tule aga abarmakedgin nakwijadyob, an peyedzhe alamas Pab-Jesúsgin-penzhulidgin unnigugal.

Al anka imis-akar olo-kurkin-chwilidikid chabolejii. Imi Pab-Jesús kannan tanikil, Pab-igal-itoged-napírragwad anka olo-kurkin uko. Tenal ankabi olo-kurkin kwen uklegojul, tenal Pab-kannan-tanikoedgin tule-pel-kwapa-pela-pela-Jesús-abintabukmaladga uklenonimogo.
Pablo aga tukin chunmajad
Tenal pedin, pe kueye-kueye anche tago.
Imi Demasdin peyedzhe iti-nap-pilaled-ulgin an-mete, ilgwen Tesalónicaje nad. Tegin Crescentedin Provincia-Galaciaje nadmo, tegin Titodin Provincia-Dalmaciaje nadmo.
Imi Lucasbi anpak wis mai. Tenal pe Marcos-amijal, anka pe chedago. Imi an takto, Marcosdin tule-nued an-pentagal Pabga arpagal.
Tenal Tíquicodin an tar-palmis, Efesoje.
Tenal pe anche alil, pe Troasgin Carpo-neggin an-chuba-ebejad, tegin karta-ebirmakaled-maid, anka pe chedabalo. Tenal we karta kege-chulgu pe anka chedago, pe melle igeo.
Tenal Alejandro-esnungad-immal-chobeddin peyedzhe ankin istar chunmadi-kus. Al Pabdin Alejandro-ankin-walmajadun, sapejul Alejandro-oturdako.
Timoteo, wijira we Alejandroje. Imi Alejandro anmal-Pab-Jesús-kaka-nuegangin-chunmalejadgin peyedzhe abin-kwisgus.

Imi tule-tummagan kepe anka igal-itogalgu, antin naga walagwen chunmas, kwenamalad-pimalad an-kwen-pentaszhul. Tenal we kwenamalad pél an-ebesmal. Imi tulemal-ankin-walmaszhulidyob, Pab we tulemal-takelen, nabirin.
Tenal Pab anpak-kwichidbal an-okannos. Al Pab-Jesús-kaka-nuegan pel-kwapa tule-Judiojulmaladga anpal nuekwa choglenoni. Tenal Pab achu-kinnidzhe-kullegued-akar an-abonosbal.
Tenal Pabdin tule-iskan-istar-an-imabied-ilbal an-abonononibalo. Tenal Pab e-neg-takmaidgin yer an-odogo ebak meggal. Imi Pab Tummad pane-pane ilagwen-nadgu otummoledi-kuelen, nabirin. Pitogua.
Tenal pe Priscaga, tegin Aquilaga tegin Onesíforo-neg-yaginmaladga pe chogo: “Antin nued mai.”
Tenal Erastodin neg-kwebur-Corintogin pes. Tegin Trófimodin neg-kwebur-Miletogin an yee tar-ebes.
Tenal pedin, ampayo ti-ni-naigueddu, pe kueyejal anche tagenab. Tegin kwenamalad-wegin-pukmalad Eubulo, Pudente, Lino, Claudia, tegin Jesúsgin-kwenamalad-pel-kwapa pemalga kaka wis palmijimo.
Imi Pab-Jesús pe-purpabak kudiguelen, nabirin. Tegin Pab pemalga immal-nuegan imakelen, nabirbalin. Pitomalgu.
